run_long_prompt_load_test: run a load test sending a 520k character prompt to a local TGI server via the OpenAI client
download_gutenberg_text: download a Project Gutenberg text file using requests and save it locally for use as test data
create_openai_client_for_tgi: create an OpenAI client pointing to a local Hugging Face TGI endpoint at localhost:8000
send_chat_completion_with_long_context: send a chat completion request with a very long user message to test context window handling
test_llm_long_prompt_throughput: test how a local LLM server handles extremely long input prompts with minimal output tokens
